goal.source_text: Minimize drag while keeping at least 100 N of downforce. Only span and chord may change.
assumptions: Darwin may change span_mm, chord_mm; it holds aoa_deg, flap_angle_deg, flap_chord_frac, endplate_height_mm fixed.
Minimizing total drag is the single objective; the 100 N downforce is treated as a hard constraint.

design_space.name: FSAE-style rear wing

parameters.name: chord_mm
parameters.description: Total chord, main element plus flap

parameters.name: flap_chord_frac
parameters.description: Flap chord as a fraction of total chord

notes: Ranges from PLAN.md B.5; W-B owns the real solver and may narrow them before CP-B.

metric_catalog.name: downforce_n
metric_catalog.description: Downforce at the design speed (VLM + viscous correction + endplates)

metric_catalog.name: drag_n
metric_catalog.description: Total drag: induced + section profile + endplate friction

metric_catalog.name: drag_profile_n
metric_catalog.description: Section profile drag (NeuralFoil) plus endplate skin friction

metric_catalog.name: cl
metric_catalog.description: Wing lift coefficient on planform area

metric_catalog.name: stall_margin_deg
metric_catalog.description: Section stall angle minus angle of attack (negative = stalled)

metric_catalog.name: span_efficiency
metric_catalog.description: Oswald e from Prandtl lifting-line theory for the planform

payload.explanation: Decreasing chord from 290 mm to 260 mm increased L/D by 5.39%, as predicted. Drag fell 13.8% (more than expected), driven by a 17.1% drop in induced drag and 6.15% drop in profile drag, while downforce decreased 9.11%, within prediction.
payload.lesson: Reducing chord improves L/D, with large induced drag cuts and moderate profile drag reduction.

payload.lesson: Reducing span lowers downforce and drag, but also L/D; span benefits are non-linear.

payload.explanation: Chord reduction and span increase lowered drag more than downforce, improving L/D by 1.33% but dropping downforce 0.907%, violating the 100N limit. Profile drag fell only 0.242%, not the predicted 2-5%, because Reynolds dropped 2.27% from the shorter chord, limiting skin friction reduction.
payload.lesson: Downforce constraint dominates; prioritize span over chord to satisfy lift while chasing drag.

payload.lesson: Further span increases give marginal L/D near the stall limit; explore other levers.

payload.explanation: Chord +5mm: downforce rose 2.014% (predicted flat, in range), but drag rose 3.018% versus predicted -2 to -8%, and L/D fell 0.974% versus predicted +1 to +6%. Drag rise driven by induced drag +3.975%, likely from reduced aspect ratio and span efficiency shift. Verdict pivot: drag reduction failed.
payload.lesson: On this wing, small chord increases hurt L/D by raising induced drag more than downforce.
